'''''Be a Stormtrooper!''''' was one of a series of [[Propaganda/Legends|recruitment]] videos issued by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] encouraging that various people in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] join the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. It also unveiled four individuals wanted for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].

The video requested that the viewer become a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and join the Imperial Army, promising that they'll be able to see the galaxy if they did so. The stormtroopers were shown in formation across the right edge of the screen as this is shown, with [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] flying overhead. As the Star Destroyer's thrusters fired up, it then unveiled a listing of four individuals wanted by the Galactic Empire for treason, including [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The last of them utilized Kenobi's Clone Wars-era image, despite the date.

The video included writing in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], and a third writing system.

==Behind the scenes==
''Be a Stormtrooper!'' and ''[[The Empire Wants You!]]'' were videos shown in the queue area of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''. The inclusion of Luke Skywalker in the list of wanted criminals seems to conflict with the attraction's setting of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
